# dsh-homepage
English | 简体中文

`dsh-homepage` gives DSH one place to browse and enter its auxiliary features. It adds an
extra surf

ace to DSH that presents different content as cards, and a card expands to offer
entry points to tho

se features — reviewing and installing an external plugin through a
delegated session, checking the

DSH core version and updating it in one click, seeing
whether sessions are running, managing local S

kills, and more. The cards are modular by
design, so any external plugin can register its own; their

artwork, layout and motion can
all be customized into a personal home page.

## Cards

Eleven cards ship: the preview shows the readings, expanding opens the full view. Click a
card to fl

oat it over the wall, drag its title to reorder, and use **Customize** for

| Card | What it does |
| **Plugin audit** | Runs a capability-limited session that statically reviews a plugin's source. Th
e host fetches the artifact from an allowlisted platform into an immutable snapshot; the session can
only read that snapshot and report a verdict. Only a source pinned to an exact version/commit can b

e installed, and installation always waits for the user's confirmation |
| **Sessions** | How many s

essions are running, waiting on you or unread, each with a shortcut into it. |
| **Projects** | Ever

y workspace's branch, dirty count, ahead/behind, last commit, session count and extra worktrees. |
|
**Tool usage** | Tool call counts, error rate, argument and output volume, estimated tokens and tim

e, filterable by project. |
| **Token usage** | Balance and today's spend, with history, wallets, bo

nus credit and account links. |
| **Network** | A quick view of the DSH core's network environment v

ariables. |
| **Device** | CPU, memory, GPU/VRAM and disk. |
| **DSH storage** | The DSH home's size

, what is reclaimable, the largest categories and old-log cleanup. |
| **DSH core** | The latest ver

sion in the DSH repository against the installed core, with a one-click update. |

ps** | Manage the sidebar groups. |

## Extending the cards

Any other plugin can add cards through the interface. The full interface documentation is
in **docs/

in **docs/card-api.md**.
## Model-facing tool

The plugin provides a model-callable `homepage` tool that reads the same data as the cards.
It is **

off by default** and has to be turned on manually in the plugin's settings on the
Plugins page. Enab

ling the tool injects its context into a session: the tool can reach the
information of every card,

including cards implemented by external plugins, and depending
on a card's implementation that may h
and the agent information it did not expect.
## Storage

The plugin stores its data under `<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh-homepage`. `<DSH_HOME>` prefers
the `DSH_H
OME` environment variable; when that variable is absent, `~/.dsh` is used.
## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome. The development loop, the repository layout and the
checks a c
hange has to pass are in CONTRIBUTING.md.
